body.name: Feedback-core inclusion-exclusion functional
body.construction: For a rooted forest component \(T\) with root \(v_T\), put \(P_{T;\mathcal U,\mathcal B,A}(x,z)=\int_0^1(A_{v_T}(y,z)+B_{v_T}(y,z))\,dy\) and \(\chi_{\mathcal U,\mathcal B}(x)=\mathbf 1\{x_u<x_f\text{ for every }f\in\mathcal B,\ u\in\mathcal U\cap N_{C_G}(f)\}\). Define \(\mathcal R_{\ell,A}(z)=\sum_{\substack{\mathcal U\subseteq\mathcal K\text{ independent}\\A\cap\mathcal K\subseteq\mathcal U}}z^{|\mathcal U|}\sum_{\mathcal B\subseteq\mathcal K\setminus\mathcal U}(-1)^{|\mathcal B|}\int_{(0,1)^{\mathcal K}}\chi_{\mathcal U,\mathcal B}(x)\prod_{f\in\mathcal K}h_{\ell f}x_f^{h_{\ell f}-1}\prod_{T\in\operatorname{comp}(C_G-\mathcal K)}P_{T;\mathcal U,\mathcal B,A}(x,z)\,dx\).
